480:t_000:36.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「Was he a friend of yours?」

480:t_000:37.en:
$$ランド$$
「...No... A lot happened, but in the end, he was an enemy.」

480:t_000:38.en:
$$ランド$$
「He was a real piece of work, but the way he was honest about his desires... It was human. I didn't hate that...」

480:t_000:39.en:
$$メール$$
「Does that mean you don't hate $$エルーナルーナ$$, either?!」

480:t_000:40.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's not what I'm talking about!」

480:t_001:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The force is mainly $$ハイアデス$$!」

480:t_001:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「But neither $$エルーナルーナ$$ nor $$ダバラーン$$ is here! Lucky us!」

480:t_001:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It is strange that their commanders are absent.」

480:t_001:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Yes... They're most likely waiting in the rear for an opening.」

480:t_002:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're getting too far ahead, $$葵$$!」

480:t_002:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「All right, $$葵$$. I'll stick with you all the way.」

480:t_002:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Thanks, $$ランド$$. I was right to pick you as my partner.」

480:t_002:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well... There's no point sending her orders now.」

480:t_002:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$葵$$ must be sensing the enemy's presence on instinct...」

480:t_002:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then we've got no choice but to fight!」

480:t_002:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「We're going for the $$ハイアデス$$ battleship! Once we bring it down, their boss will show up!」

480:t_002:9.en:
$$葵$$
「Here I come, $$ハイアデス$$! You're going to feel this fire in my blood!」

480:t_004:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you finally showed up, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_004:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, darling!」

480:t_004:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry. You aren't the one I came to see today, darling.」

480:t_004:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「She isn't listening to him at all!」

480:t_004:5.en:
$$シリウス$$
「With nerve like that, 'thickheaded cow' is a fitting name!」

480:t_004:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The one I'm after today is...」

480:t_005:0.en:
$$葵$$
「I'm honored. A personal invitation from the $$新地球皇国$$'s Supreme Commander herself.」

480:t_005:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That's right. ...Don't you think we're a little alike?」

480:t_005:3.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is no time to agree with her!」

480:t_005:5.en:
$$葵$$
「If she's stealing my act, that's all the more reason! I'll beat her right here!」

480:t_007:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「HA! You underestimated $$プレイアデス・タウラ$$'s horns!」

480:t_007:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now it's my turn!」

480:t_008:4.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The $$断空剣$$ is a physical manifestation of $$チームＤ$$'s mental energy...」

480:t_008:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So if it broke, their minds must have suffered severe damage as well.」

480:t_008:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「If their mental energy forms the blade, they can just make it again!」

480:t_008:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It's no use, darling. Their wild spirit is already dead.」

480:t_008:10.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「For beasts, it's kill or be killed. That's why the fight is decided in an instant.」

480:t_008:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And defeat means death... They lost to me, and their spirits died completely.」

480:t_008:12.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You'd call them beaten dogs.」

480:t_008:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's a lie! I can't believe that!」

480:t_008:18.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$ランド$$! Get $$葵$$ out of there!」

480:t_008:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「For wild animals, defeat means death... $$エルーナルーナ$$ is right.」

480:t_008:23.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If we have them fall back now, they will remain dead forever.」

480:t_009:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll hold this spot until $$葵$$ and the others wake up!」

480:t_009:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Everyone! I'll stay here and protect $$葵$$'s team! I'm counting on you to handle $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_009:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Aww... So darling's going to babysit that girl.」

480:t_009:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Fine. Once I finish off the others, let's have ourselves some real fun.」
